# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.11

Review build based directly on the 0.6.5 UI baseline for DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`.

## Changed

- Restored the enhanced Scheduler UI as the main Automation tasks surface: cards, search, Active/All/Inactive counters, Today/Overdue/Recurring filters and Date/Dialog grouping remain unchanged from the 0.6.5 baseline.
- Removed the Edit/History navigation path through `sidebarRight`, so those actions no longer switch the main view to the source conversation.
- Added an in-page bridge to DSH's shipped `TaskManagerPage`. The native task list is hidden inside the bridge and only its real `TaskDetail` is shown in the plugin's existing right column.
- Edit selects native Rules. History selects native Delivery records.
- Native DSH date/time controls, validation, save flow and delivery-history rendering are reused directly.
- Delivery popup, attention indicators, sidebar counters and overdue behavior are unchanged.

## Scope

This build intentionally starts from commit `ab4a0c53457b8d204bd86157e54a83d7e7004171` (0.6.5) rather than layering the 0.6.6-0.6.10 architecture experiments.
